subject.title: Remote-Only Overlay Detection Misses Some Proprietary Remote Desktop Sessions

question: Which proprietary remote-control signals should Nameplate treat as an active remote viewer for remote-only overlays?
rationale: The source gap is real, but choosing TeamViewer or AnyDesk process names, ports, or helper states is a false-positive policy decision without real active-session samples.

options.title: Gather Real Session Signals First
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers or contributors provide redacted process and connection samples from active proprietary remote sessions, then add only high-confidence rules.

options.title: Add Conservative Known Rules
options.body: Implement a small allowlist of active-session ports or helpers now and rely on tests to prevent obvious idle-app false positives.

options.title: Limit To Apple/VNC
options.body: Document remote-only mode as best-effort for virtual-display, Apple Screen Sharing, and VNC workflows rather than expanding proprietary detection.

recommendation.title: Gather Real Session Signals First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers or contributors provide redacted process and connection samples from active proprietary remote sessions, then add only high-confidence rules.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced and recently maintained the remote-only detection surface, so they are the best available owner for the false-positive policy choice.
